remarks: Beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse-style condominium offering 832 square feet plus a versatile bonus room in the lower level. Freshly painted throughout, this move-in-ready home features new hardwood floors, an updated kitchen with new cabinetry, quartz countertops, and new appliances, updated bathrooms, and new AC units for added comfort. The spacious layout includes bright living areas, two well-sized bedrooms, a private deck, and a garage. Enjoy the beautifully maintained in-ground pool nestled among mature trees, along with the benefit of low common charges. Ideally situated on a desirable cul-de-sac and conveniently located near Oak Hills Park, featuring an 18-hole golf course, walking trails and tennis courts, as well as Kendall Elementary School, Odeen's Restaurant, shopping, dining, major highways, and Metro-North transportation. With extensive updates already completed, there is nothing left to do but move in and enjoy. Rentals are permitted with a minimum one-year lease, subject to the association's rental cap, and two pets are permitted. A wonderful opportunity to own an updated home in a convenient Norwalk location.
